description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans identifier types such as GrainId, UniqueKey, SiloAddress, and GrainReference, verifying serialization, parsing, interning, and other related functionalities.

classes.name: IdentifierTests
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for Orleans identifier types and related functionalities.

classes.name: A
classes.description: A simple base class used in inheritance tests within the test suite.

classes.name: B
classes.description: A class inheriting from A, used in inheritance tests within the test suite.

methods.name: GrainIdUniformHashCodeIsStable
methods.description: Verifies that the hash code generated by GrainId.GetUniformHashCode() is stable and matches an expected value.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsNullKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that creating a UniqueKey with a null key extension throws ArgumentNullException.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsEmptyKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that creating a UniqueKey with an empty key extension throws ArgumentException.

methods.name: UniqueKeyKeyExtGrainCategoryDisallowsWhiteSpaceKeyExtension
methods.description: Tests that creating a UniqueKey with a whitespace key extension throws ArgumentException.

methods.name: ParsingUniqueKeyStringificationShouldReproduceAnIdenticalObject
methods.description: Ensures that serializing and then parsing a UniqueKey reproduces the original object accurately.

methods.name: GrainIdShouldEncodeAndDecodePrimaryKeyGuidCorrectly
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of GrainId with Guid primary keys over multiple iterations.

methods.name: GrainId_ToFromPrintableString
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of GrainId to and from its string representation.

methods.name: GrainId_TryParseFromPrintableString
methods.description: Tests the TryParse method for GrainId from its string representation.

methods.name: GrainId_RoundTripJsonConverter
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization and deserialization round-trip for GrainId.

methods.name: TestGrainIds
methods.description: Provides sample GrainId data for parameterized tests.

methods.name: UniqueTypeCodeDataShouldStore32BitsOfInformation
methods.description: Checks that the BaseTypeCode of a UniqueKey stores 32 bits of information.

methods.name: UniqueKeysShouldPreserveTheirPrimaryKeyValueIfItIsGuid
methods.description: Verifies that UniqueKey objects with Guid primary keys preserve their value and key extension after creation.

methods.name: UniqueKeysShouldPreserveTheirPrimaryKeyValueIfItIsLong
methods.description: Verifies that UniqueKey objects with long primary keys preserve their value and key extension after creation.

methods.name: ID_Interning_GrainID
methods.description: Tests interning of GrainId objects to ensure identical IDs reference the same object.

methods.name: ID_Interning_string_equals
methods.description: Tests string interning to ensure identical strings are interned and serialized correctly.

methods.name: ID_Intern_FindOrCreate_derived_class
methods.description: Tests interning behavior for objects of derived classes.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress
methods.description: Tests interning of SiloAddress objects to ensure identical addresses reference the same object.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress2
methods.description: Verifies that different SiloAddress objects are not interned if they are not equal.

methods.name: Interning_SiloAddress_Serialization
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of interned SiloAddress objects.

methods.name: SiloAddress_ToFrom_ParsableString
methods.description: Tests conversion of SiloAddress to and from its parsable string representation.

methods.name: TestGrainReference
methods.description: Helper method to test GrainReference serialization and round-trip equality.

methods.name: RoundTripGrainReferenceToKey
methods.description: Converts a GrainReference to a string and back to test serialization consistency.
